video_title: Spurs win Game 7 and Advance to The Finals

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's impact on the Spurs' Game 7 victory
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama was very good. He was very good.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Victor Wembanyama was very good. He was very good.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He didn't let like ever since really Game 1. He had a really good game in Game 4, but it's not like he's been doing. No, he's been really he's been he's been really good too.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Dort's struggles and Josh Giddey's role in the series
quotes.excerpt: Lou Dort had nowhere to guard in the series and couldn't hit a shot.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Lou Dort had nowhere to guard in the series and couldn't hit a shot and should not have been on the court nearly as much as he was. It was a giant mistake and it was obvious to see.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Jalen Williams and AJ Mitchell being out left an enormous burden on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander where he had to handle the ball all the time and they had no one else to really go to to do anything.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren's disappointing performance in Game 7
quotes.excerpt: Chet played 33 minutes tonight and you had to look hard to find him a lot of times.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Chet played 33 minutes tonight and you had to look hard to find him a lot of times. Two shot attempts in 33 minutes, four points, four rebounds. Come on now.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: They're basically playing without AJ Mitchell, Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren. And they were in a one-possession game in the end of the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's role as a cerebral problem solver
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is an incredibly cerebral player and he's a realist and he's savvy.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson is an incredibly cerebral player and he's a realist and he's savvy and all that stuff. He's one of the best problem solvers in the NBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He got the ball ripped away from him very early by Keldon Johnson.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' success built on high lottery draft picks
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs are going to the Finals primarily because they drafted three absolute studs.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The Spurs are going to the Finals primarily because they drafted three absolute studs with very high lottery picks in back-to-back-to-back drafts. Guys like Victor Wembanyama, these developmental success stories that have become essential role players are critical on any championship team.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I talked to a scout and he said, I'll be the first to bitch about how lucky they've gotten in the lottery, but I got to tell you, they have crushed the draft.
